description:
اسم التحدي Abandoned but not forgotten

اسم الفريقLuna Crafters
summary: A short cinematic scientific documentary, 4 to 5 minutes long, about 3 space rovers-Lunokhod1, Spirit and Opportunity-their missions ended, but their discoveries still affect science to this day.
details: Out project is called Abandoned But Not Forgotten. It talks about the vehicles that were left on the Moon and Mars after their missions ended, like Spirit, Opportunity, and Lunokhod 1. We bring their story back again and explain what they discovered and why they stopped, so we can learn from them and build better vehicles in the future and protect the Moon and Mars.
